title: Sexual Intercourse
summary: Sexual intercourse usually means penetrative sex, most commonly penis-in-vagina, but people use 'sex' for a wide range of activities including oral, anal and manual sex.
key_points: What counts as 'sex' differs between people.
Penis-in-vagina sex can lead to pregnancy; any sexual contact can pass STIs.
answer_guidance: Answer educationally and non-graphically; mention protection and consent when relevant.
